help_articles.title: Cancellation policies for your stay
help_articles.summary: Every listing uses one of four cancellation policies. The policy is shown on the listing page, on the Confirm and pay page and in your trip details.

blocks.text: Flexible
Free cancellation until 1 day before check-in. After that, the first night, the service fee and taxes are non-refundable; the remaining nights and the cleaning fee are refunded.
Moderate
Free cancellation until 5 days before check-in. After that, the first night, the service fee and taxes are non-refundable; you get 50% of the remaining nights back, plus the full cleaning fee.
Firm
Free cancellation until 30 days before check-in. Cancel at least 7 days before check-in to get 50% of the nightly rate back, plus the full cleaning fee. No refund after that.
Strict

Free cancellation for 48 hours after booking, if check-in is at least 14 days away. Cancel at least 7 days before check-in to get 50% of the nightly rate back, plus the full cleaning fee. No refund after that.
How refunds are calculated

Refunds are based on the number of days left before check-in on the day you cancel. Inside the free-cancellation window you get everything back, including the service fee and taxes. Outside it, the service fee and taxes are not refunded.

“Nightly rate” means the nightly price multiplied by the number of nights, after any weekly or monthly stay discount. The cleaning fee is refunded in full whenever part of the nightly rate is refunded.
The exact refund for your reservation is shown before you confirm a cancellation.

help_articles.title: How to cancel your reservation as a guest
help_articles.summary: You can cancel an upcoming reservation or an unanswered request from Trips.

items: Go to Trips and select the reservation you want to cancel.
Select Cancel reservation (or Cancel request for a request the Host hasn’t accepted).
Review the refund you’ll get and choose the reason you’re cancelling.
Select Confirm cancellation.

blocks.text: Your refund goes back to the payment method you used to book and appears in Payments & payouts. The reservation stays in Trips with the status Canceled.
Cancelling a request
If the Host hasn’t accepted your request yet, you haven’t been charged, so cancelling a request is always free.
Cancellation options

To see how much you would get back before you book, check the cancellation policy on the listing page. You can also turn on the Free cancellation filter in search to only see listings with a Flexible or Moderate policy.

help_articles.title: AirCover for guests
help_articles.summary: Every booking includes AirCover: protection from the moment you book until you check out.

items: Booking Protection Guarantee: if a Host cancels your reservation shortly before check-in, we’ll help you find a similar or better home, or refund you.
Check-In Guarantee: if you can’t check into your home and the Host can’t resolve the issue, we’ll help you find a similar or better home for the length of your original stay, or refund you.
Get-What-You-Booked Guarantee: if at any time during your stay your listing isn’t as advertised, you’ll have three days to report it.
24-hour Safety Line: if you ever feel unsafe, you get priority access to specially-trained safety agents, day or night.

blocks.text: AirCover is included with every reservation at no extra cost. It doesn’t change the cancellation policy of your booking; see Cancellation policies for your stay.

help_articles.title: Airbnb service fees for guests
help_articles.summary: Guests pay a service fee that helps Airbnb run smoothly. It’s shown in the price breakdown before you book.

blocks.text: The guest service fee is 14.2% of the booking subtotal. The subtotal is the nightly price multiplied by the number of nights, minus any weekly or monthly stay discount, plus the cleaning fee.
Taxes

Occupancy taxes are calculated on the same subtotal. The tax rate depends on where the listing is located, and some places don’t charge occupancy taxes on short stays. Taxes appear as a separate line in the price breakdown.
Rounding
Prices are charged in US dollars and every line of the price breakdown is rounded to the nearest whole dollar.
Search results and listing cards show the total before taxes for your dates.

help_articles.title: Weekly and monthly stay discounts
help_articles.summary: Some Hosts offer a discount for longer stays.

items: Weekly discount: applies to stays of 7 nights or more.
Monthly discount: applies to stays of 28 nights or more and replaces the weekly discount.

blocks.text: The discount is taken off the nightly subtotal before the cleaning fee, service fee and taxes are added. When your dates qualify, the discount appears as its own line in the price breakdown on the listing page and on the Confirm and pay page.
Stays can be booked for up to 90 nights.

help_articles.title: Instant Book and reservation requests
help_articles.summary: Some homes can be booked instantly. For others, you send a request to the Host.

blocks.text: Instant Book
Listings with Instant Book are confirmed as soon as you confirm and pay. Use the Instant Book filter under Booking options to only see these listings.
Request to book

For other listings, send a request with a message to the Host explaining your trip. A message is required. The Host has 24 hours to respond, and you won’t be charged unless the request is accepted. Pending requests appear in Trips.

help_articles.title: Adding and removing payment methods
help_articles.summary: Manage your cards in Account > Payments & payouts.

blocks.text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover credit and debit cards.

items: To add a card, go to Payments & payouts and select Add payment method. You can also add a card on the Confirm and pay page.
To choose which card is selected first at checkout, select Set default.
To remove a card, select Remove. A card used for an upcoming reservation can’t be removed.

blocks.text: Your payment history, including refunds, is listed on the same page.

help_articles.title: Where to find your receipt
help_articles.summary: Every reservation has a receipt with the full price breakdown.

items: Go to Trips and select the reservation.
Select Get receipt.

blocks.text: The receipt shows the confirmation code, the nights and nightly price, the cleaning fee, the service fee, taxes, the card that was charged and any refund.

help_articles.title: Writing a review after your stay
help_articles.summary: You have 14 days after checkout to review your stay.

items: Go to Trips and select the completed stay.
Select Write a review.
Give an overall star rating and rate cleanliness, accuracy, check-in, communication, location and value.
Describe your stay. You can also leave a private note that only the Host sees.

blocks.text: Reviews can be submitted within 14 days after checkout and can’t be edited after they’re submitted. Reviews for canceled reservations aren’t possible.

help_articles.title: How star ratings work
help_articles.summary: Listings show an overall rating and six category ratings.

blocks.text: The overall rating is the average of the star ratings guests have given. Listings without reviews yet are shown as New.
Category ratings cover cleanliness, accuracy, check-in, communication, location and value.
Guest favorites
Guest favorites are the most loved homes on Airbnb, based on ratings, reviews and reliability. Use the Guest favorite filter under Standout stays to find them.

help_articles.title: Messaging your Host
help_articles.summary: Contact a Host before you book or during your trip.

items: Before booking: select Message host on the listing page.
After booking: select Message (followed by your Host’s name) in your trip details.
All conversations are in Messages. Unread conversations are marked.

blocks.text: Keep all communication in Messages so there’s a record of what was agreed.

help_articles.title: Saving homes to a wishlist
help_articles.summary: Wishlists help you keep track of places you like.

items: Select the heart on a listing to save it. Choose an existing wishlist or create a new one.
Open Wishlists from the account menu to see everything you’ve saved.
To rename or delete a wishlist, open it and select Settings. Wishlist names can be up to 50 characters.

help_articles.title: Searching for a place to stay
help_articles.summary: Search by destination and dates, then narrow results with filters.

blocks.text: Enter a destination, your dates and the number of guests. Results are shown in order of relevance.
Filters

items: Type of place: entire home, private room, shared room or hotel room.
Price range: the nightly price before fees and taxes.
Rooms and beds: minimum bedrooms, beds and bathrooms.
Amenities, such as Wifi, kitchen, washer or a dedicated workspace.
Booking options: Instant Book, Self check-in, Free cancellation and Allows pets.
Standout stays: Guest favorite and Superhost.
Property type: house, apartment, guesthouse or hotel.

blocks.text: Some destination names match more than one place, like Portland. Include the state or country to make sure you’re searching the right one.

help_articles.title: Editing your personal info
help_articles.summary: Update your name, contact details, address and emergency contact.

items: Open the account menu and select Account.
Select Personal info.
Edit the details you want to change and select Save.

blocks.text: Your legal name should match your government ID. Hosts see your preferred first name if you add one.

help_articles.title: Changing your password
help_articles.summary: Update your password from Login & security.

items: Go to Account > Login & security.
Enter your current password and your new password twice.
Select Update password.

blocks.text: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.

help_articles.title: Deactivating your account
help_articles.summary: Account deactivation is handled by our support team.

blocks.text: Accounts can’t be deactivated online. Before you ask our support team to deactivate your account, cancel any upcoming reservations and save the receipts you need; deactivated accounts lose access to Trips, Messages and Wishlists.
If you only want to stop getting booked as a Host or change how you’re contacted, you don’t need to deactivate your account.

help_articles.title: How we estimate what you could earn
help_articles.summary: The Airbnb it page gives an estimate based on similar homes near you.

blocks.text: The estimate uses the median nightly price of entire-home listings in your city with the same number of bedrooms as your place. If there are none, it uses all entire-home listings in the city.
The median nightly price is multiplied by the number of nights you plan to host each month. The estimate doesn’t subtract Host fees, cleaning costs or taxes.

help_articles.title: How to become a Superhost
help_articles.summary: Superhosts are experienced Hosts who provide great stays.

items: An overall rating of 4.8 or higher.
At least 10 completed stays, or 3 stays that total at least 100 nights.
A cancellation rate below 1%.
A response rate of 90% or higher.

blocks.text: Superhost status is reviewed every three months. Guests can filter for Superhosts under Standout stays.
